material.acceptance_criteria: Every failure path in main.js (frame exception, rejected reload, watch stop, map.bin non-2xx, unhandled rejection) produces exactly one POST /client-error whose message names the path, and that line appears in the server log.
material.description: rust/crates/web/site/main.js posts to /client-error only from the main().catch handler. The requestAnimationFrame frame() loop, watchMod's rejected-reload path and its stopped-watch path (console.error only), a map.bin non-2xx answer, window error events and unhandledrejection events are not relayed. The CI browser steps post with curl, never from the page.
material.resolution: Every page failure path (frame loop, rejected reloads, watch stop, poll and map fetch failures, window error, unhandledrejection, main().catch) posts an ev=client_error line via reportClientError. CI probes an uncaught error and a rejected promise and asserts one line each.
material.subject: Browser failure paths outside the first main() chain never reach /client-error
material.witness: ci-status for 00252210245cf02ae3224e444ab3974658093a4c; ci.yml map renders job lines 306-327
material.witness_plan: The browser CI job loads the page with rejectReloads=5 and a frame-throw query flag, then greps the http.log for one ev=client_error line per path, each carrying the page session id.
